neet_phy_u18_t03_1.working: The Balmer series (transitions ending at n=2) falls in the visible region, at about 365–656 nm.

neet_phy_u18_t03_2.working: The maximum number of lines is n(n-1)/2 = 5×4/2 = 10.

neet_phy_u18_t03_4.working: Lyman has n1=1 (UV), Balmer n1=2 (visible), Paschen n1=3 (IR) and Pfund n1=5 (IR). This gives A-II, B-III, C-IV, D-I.

neet_phy_u18_t03_5.working: A is false because the series limit is the shortest wavelength. B is true. C is true: λL/λB = (5/36)/(3/4) = 5/27. D is false because atoms at room temperature are in the ground state, so absorption shows Lyman lines. E is true. So B, C and E are correct.
